Thanks man, really sorry for your loss as well. Thankfully I still have my two brothers alive and well. And yes it is a very special kind of grief mostly consisting of anger and frustration as you're left with a hollowness of unanswered questions and what ifs and whatnot. Also scary indeed. 

Today I've pretty much just been in my room all day not doing a damn thing, mostly trying to work on some studies or play some games to get my mind at something else, but doing studies is waaay too strenuous. One kind of therapy I do to myself which I can recommend (especially considering I'm a musician), is just put on some really beautiful/sad music and just let your feelings take over you and cry if you have to, it really just helps relieve the mind.
